description: Canonical structure for the machine-readable Client Guide input/output produced by the Client Guide skill (Run of Show Step 4). The build script consumes this JSON and emits paired Client Guide.md + Client Guide.docx deliverables. Downstream skills (clip-table) read the same shape. If a field is added/renamed/reordered, edit this schema first, then update the skill prose. Bump `version` and append to `version_history` on every change.

version_history.change: Initial schema. Captures: episode_topic, practice_area, firm, attorney, scope, location, episode_overview (intro paragraph + metadata + episode_plan outline), pre_interview_prep (things_to_think_about + things_to_do), segments (intro + ordered segment list with name + description + questions + duration + outro), faq (Q/A list).

Attorney response bullets now ship in the Client Guide. Replaced the simple `questions: array<string>` per segment with `questions: array<{q_text, attorney_response_bullets: array<{label, detail}>}>`. The bullets are pulled verbatim from the source Client ROS so the attorney has the full mandatory infill in their prep doc. Backward-compatible read path: build script falls back to legacy string-only questions when the new shape is absent.

Three-field geo model terminology alignment (Gabe directive, Whalen scoping). Docs-only PATCH - no structural field change. Clarified the `scope` and `location` field descriptions against the canonical three-field geo model: Targeting strategy (single-location vs multi-location), Optimization scope (show anchor) = City/State/County/Regional, Episode geo target = the specific city each episode is built to rank for. `scope` remains the internal ROS-derivation scope label (Topic Only/Location/Extension), a different axis from the show anchor; `location` carries the inherited Episode geo target. Anchor scope != per-episode target - the show anchors broad while each episode targets its own city; city emphasis is a ceiling, never a floor.

episode_topic.description: Plain-language episode topic (e.g., 'How to File a Car Accident Claim in California'). Sourced from the Client ROS metadata block.

practice_area.description: Title-cased practice area name (e.g., 'Car Accidents'). Matches the {Practice Area} folder under templates [master]/AEO/Podcast/Entity Research/.

firm.description: Law firm name as it should appear on the cover and header (e.g., 'The May Firm', 'Sutliff & Stout').

attorney.description: Attorney name being prepped (e.g., 'Robert May'). Used in narrative voice and FAQ references.

scope.description: Internal ROS-derivation scope label of the parent Client ROS this guide derives from. Drives cover-page subtitle formatting. This is a different axis from the show-level Optimization scope (show anchor) = City/State/County/Regional and from the client's Targeting strategy (single-location vs multi-location); it is not the show anchor breadth.

location.required: conditional - required when scope is Location or Extension
location.description: The episode's Episode geo target - the specific city/jurisdiction this episode is built to rank for (e.g., 'California', 'CA - Long Beach'), inherited verbatim from the Client ROS, not re-derived here. Anchor scope != per-episode target: the show can anchor broad (e.g. the state) while this episode targets its own city. City emphasis in the copy is a ceiling, never a floor. Format defined in the canonical Podcast Drive doc.

host.description: CE host name on the recording (e.g., 'Kara'). Populates FAQ references like 'Kara will lead the conversation'.

episode_overview.description: Top section of the deliverable. Leads with the value proposition to the attorney's business, then declares metadata, then renders the Episode Plan outline.

value_prop.description: 2-3 sentence paragraph answering 'what does this recording do for my practice?' SEO visibility, trust building, authority, command of jurisdiction. Drives the lead paragraph of the Episode Overview section.

metadata.description: Metadata sub-block rendered as bold key/value lines under '### Metadata'.

episode_topic.description: Episode title in plain language. Mirrors top-level episode_topic.

estimated_duration.description: Range string (e.g., '~50-60 minutes'). Always a range, never a single number.

question_count.description: Total number of host questions across all segments. Used in the duration line.

segment_count.description: Number of content segments (excluding intro and outro). Used in the duration line.

episode_plan.description: Nested-bullet outline of the recording structure. Conventional shape: Pre-Show Checks, Episode (Intro + S1..SN + Outro), Post-Show Wrap-up. Each item is a single string; nested children are encoded by leading whitespace or rendered inline by the build script.

pre_interview_prep.description: Two-section prep block. Always rendered with the bold-lead-sentence + regular-detail bullet format ('**Bold lead.** Detail').

things_to_think_about.description: Reflective mindset prompts. Frame as 'How would you explain X?', 'What do you wish every client knew about Y?'. Derived from Client ROS content; not actionable tasks.

lead.description: Bold lead sentence, ends with a period (e.g., 'California's pure comparative negligence system.').

detail.description: Regular-weight detail that elaborates on the lead.

things_to_do.description: Actionable prep items. Specific research to pull, materials to gather, data to confirm. Always include 'Have your contact information ready' as one item.

lead.description: Bold lead sentence, ends with a period.

segments.description: Segment Breakdown content. Intro and outro are structural (no questions); content segments carry per-segment description + questions list + duration.

intro_description.description: Italic paragraph explaining what happens in the intro and the attorney's role. No questions listed; intro is structural.

intro_duration.description: Display duration string for the intro section.

list.description: Ordered list of content segments (S1, S2, ...). Render in array order.

name.description: Segment title (e.g., 'At the Scene - What to Do Right Now'). Will be prefixed with 'S{N}: ' on render.

description.description: Italic segment-goal paragraph: WHY this segment exists, what it accomplishes for the listener. Derived from Client ROS producer notes (translated into client language).

duration.description: Display duration string for this segment (e.g., '~10 minutes').

questions.description: Exact host questions from the Client ROS, each with the attorney-response bullets attached as sub-items. Numbered Q1..Q{N} on render in segment order, continuing across segments. ACCEPTS TWO SHAPES for backward compatibility: (a) v1.1 canonical shape - an array of objects {q_text, attorney_response_bullets}; (b) v1.0 legacy shape - an array of plain strings (no bullets rendered, question line only). The build script auto-detects and renders accordingly.

q_text.description: Exact question text from the Client ROS, cleaned of producer notes / entity bracketing / inline annotations. Rendered as the parent bullet `- Q{N}: {q_text}`.

attorney_response_bullets.description: Attorney coverage checklist for this question, pulled verbatim from the source Client ROS's `attorney_bullets` array under the matching question. Rendered as indented sub-bullets under the parent Q bullet: `  - **{label}** {detail}` in markdown, indented List Bullet 2 with bold lead + regular detail in DOCX. Pandoc `[entity]{.underline}` runs inside label or detail are preserved (rendered as DOCX underline runs, stripped to plain text in .md per existing convention). 3-6 sub-bullets per Q is typical.

label.description: Bold lead phrase ending with a colon (e.g., 'Inventory every category of loss:'). Pulled verbatim from the source Client ROS bullet's `**Label:**` prefix. May contain pandoc `[entity]{.underline}` runs.

detail.description: Regular-weight detail following the label. Pulled verbatim from the source Client ROS bullet's detail clause. May contain pandoc `[entity]{.underline}` runs.

outro_description.description: Italic paragraph for the outro: host wraps, directs listeners to the firm. Mentions website, phone, free consultation.

outro_duration.description: Display duration string for the outro section.

faq.description: 5 seed FAQs (always included) + 2-3 episode-specific FAQs. Format: bold question, plain-text answer.

question.description: FAQ question, ends with question mark. Will render bolded with leading bullet.

metadata.description: Optional provenance block. Internal-only; not rendered into the deliverable but useful for audit when present.

version.description: Schema version used to produce this guide.

source_client_ros_path.description: Drive path of the Client ROS this guide was translated from.

scrub_result.description: Result of the sensitive-data scrub (internal tool names, ROS phrase, entity architecture). 'flagged' means at least one hit was caught and corrected.
